verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird documents a venture capital practice, a TwoVenture hub with a 'Start & Seed' section, and a free German Term Sheet Generator 'for early financing rounds', which together amount to a stated early-stage financing practice with a published form. Nothing in the evidence mentions SAFEs, convertible notes or other convertible instruments specifically. Missing for 10: any explainer, form or practice statement on SAFEs or convertible instruments, explicit pre-seed coverage, and independent corroboration of early-stage deal experience.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents deep experience with SAFEs and convertible instruments for pre-seed and seed rounds — published explainers, forms, or a stated early-stage financing practice

citations.quote: A hub to provide guidance to start-up and scale-up companies and their investors through the venture capital life cycle
automate the production of a simplified Term Sheet for early financing rounds in Germany
Bird & Bird is a leading international legal adviser to high-growth companies within the venture capital ecosystem
